verdict.rationale: A built-in AI assistant is a fair question for a back-office SaaS platform like Firstbase, so the axis applies. The evidence shows only human services: a dedicated bookkeeper reachable through built-in messaging, and a legal 'Registered Agent' service. Neither is an AI assistant, so there is no evidence of delegating tasks to built-in AI.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
